name: Peter Zylka-Greger
bio: Years with teams around the world taught me that people want to contribute and be part of something successful. We just need to let them work. I coach teams and leaders on flow and forecasting, and make sure Lighthouse fits how they really deliver.

name: Benjamin Huser-Berta
bio: Software engineer and Scrum Master. Work can be creative and fun when we reduce waste and focus on delivering value. That's how I build Lighthouse: small releases, about one a week, shaped by what teams ask for.
